using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace UnityEngine
{
    public class Object
    {
        public bool Destroyed;
        public static void Destroy(Object value)
        {
            if (ReferenceEquals(value, null)) return;
            value.Destroyed = true;
            var go = value as GameObject;
            if (!ReferenceEquals(go, null))
            {
                if (go.Owner != null) go.Owner.Destroyed = true;
                if (go.Item != null) go.Item.DestroyTree();
            }
        }
        public static bool operator ==(Object a, Object b)
        {
            bool an = ReferenceEquals(a, null) || (!ReferenceEquals(a, null) && a.Destroyed);
            bool bn = ReferenceEquals(b, null) || (!ReferenceEquals(b, null) && b.Destroyed);
            return an || bn ? an == bn : ReferenceEquals(a, b);
        }
        public static bool operator !=(Object a, Object b) => !(a == b);
        public override bool Equals(object value) => ReferenceEquals(this, value);
        public override int GetHashCode() => System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetHashCode(this);
    }
    public class GameObject : Object
    {
        public string name;
        public Object Owner;
        internal Item Item;
        public bool Active;
        public void SetActive(bool value) { Active = value; }
    }
}

static class UniTask { public static Task Yield() => ModBehaviour.Instance.Flow.Steps[3].Task; }
class Item : UnityEngine.Object
{
    public Flow Flow;
    public UnityEngine.GameObject gameObject;
    public int DestroyedCopies;
    public Item() { gameObject = new UnityEngine.GameObject { Owner = this }; }
    public void DestroyTree() { Destroyed = true; DestroyedCopies++; UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(gameObject); }
}
class ItemTreeData
{
    public Flow Flow;
    public static async Task<Item> InstantiateAsync(ItemTreeData data) { await data.Flow.Steps[0].Task; return data.Flow.Item; }
}

    public ItemTreeData itemTreeData;

{
    public Task<Item> LoadOrCreateCharacterItemInstance(int id) => throw new Exception("fallback not expected");

    { await item.Flow.Steps[1].Task; return item.Flow.Character; }

class LevelManager { public static LevelManager Instance = new LevelManager(); public CharacterCreator CharacterCreator = new CharacterCreator(); }
static class GameplayDataSettings { public static class ItemAssets { public const int DefaultCharacterItemTypeID = 1; } }
class DeadBodySpawnContext_DeathWraith { }
class Flow
{
    public readonly TaskCompletionSource<bool>[] Steps = new TaskCompletionSource<bool>[5];
    public readonly Item Item;
    public readonly CharacterMainControl Character;
    public readonly WraithInfo Info;
    public Flow(int pendingStage)
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < Steps.Length; i++)
        { Steps[i] = new TaskCompletionSource<bool>(); if (i < pendingStage) Steps[i].SetResult(true); }
        Item = new Item { Flow = this };
        Character = new CharacterMainControl { Flow = this };
        Character.gameObject = new UnityEngine.GameObject { Owner = Character, Item = Item };
        Info = new WraithInfo { itemTreeData = new ItemTreeData { Flow = this } };
    }
    public void Complete() { foreach (var step in Steps) step.TrySetResult(true); }
}
class ModBehaviour : UnityEngine.Object
{
    public static ModBehaviour Instance;
    public Flow Flow;
    public bool Enabled = true;
    private int deathWraithSpawnGeneration;
    private HashSet<uint> spawningWraithRaidIds = new HashSet<uint>();
    private Dictionary<uint, CharacterMainControl> activeWraithsByRaidId = new Dictionary<uint, CharacterMainControl>();
    private Dictionary<CharacterMainControl, uint> activeWraithRaidIdByCharacter = new Dictionary<CharacterMainControl, uint>();
    private List<DeadBodySpawnContext_DeathWraith> pendingDeadBodySpawnContexts = new List<DeadBodySpawnContext_DeathWraith>();
    private object _deathWraithListCache;
    private bool _deathWraithListDirty;
    private float _deathWraithListDirtySince;
    public void Spawn(Flow flow) { Flow = flow; TrySpawnStoredDeathWraithForRaid_DeathWraith(7, new Vector3()); }
    public void Reload() { OnSetFile_DeathWraith(); }
    public bool Pending => spawningWraithRaidIds.Contains(7);
    public int Active => activeWraithsByRaidId.Count;
    public static void DevLog(string value) { }
    private bool IsDeathWraithSystemEnabled() => Enabled;
    private WraithInfo FindStoredDeathWraithInfoByRaidId_DeathWraith(uint id) => Flow.Info;
    private CharacterModel GetMainCharacterModelPrefab_DeathWraith(LevelManager level) => new CharacterModel();
    private void RestoreWraithItemRuntimeStateRecursive_DeathWraith(Item item, string context) { }
    private void ApplyStoredWraithFaceData_DeathWraith(CharacterMainControl character, WraithInfo info) { }
    private Task EnsureStoredBoundMeleeEquipped_DeathWraith(CharacterMainControl character, WraithInfo info) => character.Flow.Steps[2].Task;
    private Task PrepareWraithCombatLoadout_DeathWraith(CharacterMainControl character) => character.Flow.Steps[4].Task;
    private void NormalizeDamageMultiplier(CharacterMainControl character) { }
    private void RestoreWraithMaxHealthSnapshot_DeathWraith(CharacterMainControl character, float value) { }
    private void ApplyBossStatMultiplier(CharacterMainControl character) { }
    private void InitializeWraithAI_DeathWraith(CharacterMainControl character, Vector3 position, WraithInfo info) { }
    private WraithTier ClassifyWraithTier_DeathWraith(int value, long wealth) => WraithTier.Weak;
    private string GetWraithDisplayName_DeathWraith(string name, WraithTier tier) => "wraith";
    private string CreateWraithDisplayNameKey_DeathWraith(string name) => name;
    private void ApplyWraithRuntimePreset_DeathWraith(CharacterMainControl character, WraithInfo info, string key, string name) { }
    private void ApplyWraithTierStats_DeathWraith(CharacterMainControl character, WraithTier tier) { }
    private void ClearPendingDeathWraithInfo_DeathWraith() { }
    private void DestroyWraithInstance_DeathWraith(CharacterMainControl character, string reason) => UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(character.gameObject);
    /* WRAITH_METHODS */
    /* WRAITH_CLEANUP */
}
class Program
{
    static void Require(bool condition, string reason) { if (!condition) throw new Exception(reason); }
    static void Main()
    {
        for (int stage = 0; stage < 5; stage++)
        {
            var host = new ModBehaviour(); ModBehaviour.Instance = host;
            var old = new Flow(stage); host.Spawn(old);
            Require(host.Pending && host.Active == 0, "old request must suspend at stage " + stage);
            host.Reload();
            var successor = new Flow(0); host.Spawn(successor);
            old.Steps[stage].SetResult(true);
            Require(host.Pending && host.Active == 0, "old finally released successor at stage " + stage);
            Require(old.Item.Destroyed, "untransferred item tree remained at stage " + stage);
            if (stage > 0) Require(old.Character.Destroyed, "late character remained at stage " + stage);
            successor.Complete();
            Require(!host.Pending && host.Active == 1 && successor.Character.gameObject.Active, "successor did not commit");
            host.Reload();
            Require(host.Active == 0 && successor.Character.Destroyed, "reload did not clean registered character");
        }
        for (int stage = 1; stage <= 2; stage++)
        {
            var host = new ModBehaviour(); ModBehaviour.Instance = host;
            var failed = new Flow(stage); host.Spawn(failed);
            failed.Steps[stage].SetException(new InvalidOperationException("factory/equipment failure"));
            Require(!host.Pending && host.Active == 0 && failed.Item.Destroyed, "failure lost owned tree");
            if (stage == 2) Require(failed.Character.Destroyed, "equipment exception orphaned character");
        }
        Console.WriteLine("PASS same-slot reload at all 5 awaits, successor request ownership, creation and equipment failure cleanup");
    }
}
